name: race_rival_hollow_refuses_orders
description: In a Tide Race my orders reach my hollow only (contract-m6.md §5): a tower placed on the rival's hollow is refused before it goes out, with the notice 'That is your rival's hollow' (the same cell sent would land on mine, which the simulation counts my cells on), its ghost red there and its gold untouched; a signal there is refused alike. The rival's tower can still be selected and read. Back on my hollow the same click builds, on my own cell.

steps.assert: node('BuildController').hover_cell == Vector2i(32, 3) and not node('BuildController').can_build('arrow', Vector2i(32, 3)) and node('BuildController').can_build('arrow', Vector2i(6, 3))
steps.msg: the rival's grass is no cell of mine to build on, my own is
the click is refused with its reason
nothing went out, no gold held back

steps.assert: count('towers') == 1 and scene.tower_at(Vector2i(6, 3)) == null and scene.tower_on(Vector2i(32, 3)) == null
steps.msg: no tower on the rival's cell, nor on my own cell of the same number
a signal on the rival's hollow is refused too
the rival's tower can still be selected and read

steps.assert: scene.tower_at(Vector2i(6, 3)) != null and scene.tower_at(Vector2i(6, 3)).owner_seat == 1 and absf(scene.tower_at(Vector2i(6, 3)).global_position.x - 6.5) < 0.001 and Game.gold == 260
steps.msg: on my hollow the click builds, on my own cell
